use_when.statement: Use an accordion to let the user expand one answer at a time without leaving the page — an FAQ list on a marketing page.
use_when.verbatim: Use an accordion to let the user expand one answer at a time without leaving the page — an FAQ list on a marketing page.

dont_use_when.verbatim: Don’t use it for primary content the user needs to see without an extra click.

placement.statement: stacked in a list, as an FAQ

a11y.fact: the header is a real <button> carrying aria-expanded and aria-controls over a role="region" panel — the disclosure pattern, so Space and Enter operate it
the panel is role="region" labelled by the header button, so its content is reachable and named
uses aria-disabled rather than the DOM attribute, keeping a disabled header focusable so it can still be read
the chevron is aria-hidden decoration; aria-expanded already conveys the state, so announcing it twice is worse
headingLevel wraps the header in a real heading, which is what lets a screen reader jump between questions in an FAQ list
